diagnosis: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS, non-germinal-center (non-GCB) phenotype by the Hans algorithm (CD10-, BCL6+, MUM1+). Hans is an immunohistochemical surrogate and is not equivalent to molecular ABC cell-of-origin by gene-expression profiling. EBER negative; CD5 negative. The left axillary node is lymphoma, not recurrent breast carcinoma: cytokeratin AE1/AE3 and GATA3 are negative and there is no epithelial component.
stage: Lugano (Ann Arbor) stage III with B symptoms (documented fevers to 38.4 C and drenching night sweats; weight loss ~3%, below 10%): FDG-avid nodes on both sides of the diaphragm (left axillary and mediastinal above; mesenteric and para-aortic below) with splenic involvement. The spleen is lymphatic tissue (a nodal site, not extranodal), so splenic nodules do not make this stage IV; there is no kidney, adrenal, liver, lung, bone, breast or CNS involvement and the bone marrow biopsy is negative. Largest mass 7.5 cm (mesenteric): below the 10 cm Lugano threshold for bulk, although some trials define bulk at 7.5 cm, so the definition varies.
biology: Double-expressor lymphoma by IHC (MYC 45%, at or above the 40% threshold; BCL2 70%, above the 50% threshold), which carries a somewhat worse prognosis with standard immunochemotherapy. Not double-hit: FISH shows no MYC, BCL2 or BCL6 rearrangement, so this is not high-grade B-cell lymphoma. Double-expressor status alone does not justify DA-EPOCH-R or other intensified regimens. Ki-67 ~80%.
prognosis: IPI 2 of 5 (low-intermediate risk): LDH elevated (510 U/L, ULN 225) and stage III. Age 59 (not >60), ECOG 1 and 0 extranodal sites (the spleen is not counted as an extranodal site) score 0. CNS-IPI 2 of 6 (intermediate risk): LDH and stage only; no kidney/adrenal involvement. Beta-2 microglobulin mildly elevated at 2.9 mg/L.
first_line_treatment: Curative-intent immunochemotherapy. Recommend Pola-R-CHP for 6 cycles as preferred (IPI >=2, POLARIX-eligible); R-CHOP for 6 cycles is an acceptable alternative. Start promptly. DA-EPOCH-R is not indicated: double-expressor status alone does not justify intensification.
cns_risk: Intermediate CNS-relapse risk (CNS-IPI 2). No high-risk anatomic sites: no kidney, adrenal, testicular or breast involvement (the axillary node is lymphoma and the breasts show no uptake), and she has no neurological symptoms. No routine CNS prophylaxis is recommended (no high-dose methotrexate, no intrathecal therapy). MRI brain and lumbar puncture only if neurological symptoms develop.
response_assessment: End-of-treatment FDG PET-CT 6-8 weeks after the last cycle, read with Lugano 2014 criteria and the Deauville 5-point scale (Deauville 1-3 = complete metabolic response). Interim PET-CT after 2-4 cycles is optional and should not change therapy unless it shows progression. Biopsy residual Deauville 4-5 uptake if it would change management. Repeat echocardiogram at end of treatment and during survivorship.
pretreatment_workup: Hepatitis B serology done: HBsAg, anti-HBc and anti-HBs nonreactive. HCV and HIV nonreactive. Baseline echocardiogram done. Bone marrow negative.
supportive_care: Tumor lysis risk is low-intermediate: oral hydration and allopurinol before cycle 1. Primary G-CSF (pegfilgrastim) with each cycle. Anastrozole can continue.
fitness_and_goals: Fit for curative therapy: ECOG 1, age 59, normal organ function. Her goal is cure.
